notes: Bullet 1 is a precondition -- you cannot hold another Weapon Skill quest -- and not a step. Bullet 2 does two things at once: Gumbah hands over the Weapon training guide key item AND the Sword of Trials, and states that the sword's latent must be broken before the rest of the quest. The '- Breaking the Latent' sub-bullet is a transclusion that did not render, so the page never actually says what the latent condition is. That requirement is recorded in step 2's note rather than as its own rung: it is unmarkable, unobservable, and sits between two steps that are both on Gumbah, where wedging it in would cost the only marker Bastok Mines has in this quest. Weapon training guide is step 1's evidence rather than the Sword of Trials, because the sword is traded back at step 2 and would go false the moment it was used. The three Western Altepa rungs (examine, fight, re-examine) are all unmarkable -- a ??? never carries a marker -- which is exactly why bullet 4's journey is kept as its own travel step: the zone is the only thing that can be drawn between Gumbah and Gumbah. notes: Bullet 3 contradicts its own first sub-bullet. The top line says trading the testimony to Shamarhaan initiates the Navukgo Execution Chamber battlefield and warps you there; the sub-bullet says that on arrival you trade the Testimony to the Decorative Bronze Gate to begin the battle. One Puppetmaster's Testimony cannot be traded twice, so either one of the two is wrong or they are two independent ways in. Both are kept as rungs -- they are in different zones and each is somewhere a player would actually stand -- both are marked medium, and the quest is medium for it. Bullet 2 names no monster: 'Farm Trolls for the testimony. Specific Trolls drop it' says outright that only some do, so recording the family name would put a marker on every Troll in Vana'diel and mobs is left empty. The remaining sub-bullets are the battle's rules -- Valkeng at his side, ten minutes, Trusts allowed with Rhapsody in Umber, Shamarhaan down to 20% -- and belong in the fight's note. The 'After the walkthrough: Notes' line says the quest is skippable if New Worlds Await is already done; that is a fact about the level cap, not a step. Level 66+ and 'Quest Reqs: Puppetmaster' are both gates.

notes: VERIFY: step 1's evidence (Trial Blade) was removed. Rule 3 requires evidence to be obtained AT the step, and the walkthrough never says Gaddiux hands the blade over -- the draft inferred it from the header's 'Item Reqs: Trial Blade' and the description, and Item Reqs is the field for what you must already HOLD, so the blade may well be in inventory before bullet 1 is ever spoken. If so it would latch step 1 true before step 1 was done. Nulling costs nothing here: both rungs are Gaddiux at Western Adoulin (J-10), so the marker is identical either way, and the ladder crosses on the session latch instead. The rest of the reading survives. Four bullets collapse to two rungs, both on Gaddiux. Bullet 2 -- accumulate 300 Weapon Skill Points on the Trial Blade -- is unquestionably something you do, and it is the whole quest, but it has no target, no zone, and nothing observable behind it: no packet reports weapon skill points, and the sub-bullet's 5/7/9/11-point skillchain table cannot be counted either. Made into a rung of its own it would sit between two steps on the same NPC and cost Gaddiux his marker for the entire grind, which is the case the pilot warns about, so it is folded into the trade it gates and kept auditable through source_bullets. Bullet 3 is an outcome -- the new weapon skill appears in your list while the blade is equipped -- and not a step. The Start field gives only 'Inventors' Coalition', so the grid (J-10) comes from bullet 1. With no observable anywhere on the page this quest is tracked by the session latch or not at all.

steps.note: by the Inventors' Coalition, as a level 99 Rune Fencer. The draft used the Trial Blade as evidence here; the walkthrough never says Gaddiux hands it over, and the header lists it under Item Reqs -- i.e. something you may already hold -- so it is not evidence that this step is done.

bullet 2 folded in: 300 Weapon Skill Points must be accumulated on the Trial Blade first, scored like Trial and Mythic weapon skills. Nothing reports that count, so it is not a rung of its own. The unlocked skill only shows while the blade is equipped; trading the blade back frees it for any weapon.

notes: The header has no Start field at all, so start is read out of bullet 1: 'any Voidwatch Officer in a Shadowreign area'. That is a name without a zone, and 'voidwatch officer' is in the resolver's AMBIGUOUS_NPCS set, where an unresolved zone means the entry is dropped rather than marking every officer in Vana'diel -- so step 1 will not draw, and choosing a Shadowreign zone to make it draw would be inventing one the page never gives. Step 2 does draw, and it is the one that matters: the Bulwark Gate at Sauromugue Champaign (S) (F-6) is a real targetable and is where the quest actually resolves. The two key items named in bullet 2's sub-bullet -- White stratum abyssite VI and Starlight Voidwatcher's emblem -- are also the header's Reward, so by the reward rule they prove the quest is over rather than that a step is done, and neither is used as evidence. The rest of bullet 1's sub-bullet is a chain of preconditions: an earlier Bulwark Gate cutscene worth 30,000 gil, then a game-day wait and a zone before any officer will hand over the alarum, and the officer must be a Shadowreign-era one. None of that is observable.
